main: Tired of salads leaving you hungry? This Greek Yogurt Cobb Salad Wrap is your answer! It's a satisfying, balanced meal that keeps you full twice as long as a regular salad, perfect for a quick 5-minute breakfast or packed lunch.
reply1:
For 1 wrap:
[Sauce]
• 2 T Greek yogurt
• 1 t mustard
• ½ t honey
• Pinch salt & pepper
[Filling]
• 1 whole wheat tortilla
• 1 hard-boiled egg
• ½ chicken breast (shredded)
• 3 cherry tomatoes (halved)
• 2 lettuce leaves
• ¼ cucumber (julienned)
reply2: Warm tortilla 30 seconds per side on a dry pan. Layer lettuce, then other ingredients in a line, zig-zagging sauce. Fold the bottom, then roll tightly like gimbap.
alt_text: A Cobb salad wrap, cut in half, revealing colorful layers of egg, chicken, tomato, and lettuce with a white Greek yogurt sauce, all wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla and presented on parchment paper.
